_about: Hand-maintained by strategy. Maps every board dimension/arm key to plain language + the organs behind it. Read by tools/scorecard.py; the GUI never sees these keys, only the plain names.

coref.name: Who 'he / she / it / they' refers to

salience.name: Which character the passage is mainly about

common_noun_coref.name: Whether 'the dog' is the same dog mentioned earlier

commonnoun_resolution.name: Resolving 'the animal' to the dog just mentioned

coref_via_reader.name: Pronoun reference as the full reader actually runs it

namebridge.name: Linking a description ('the painter') to a named person

affected_entity.name: Who was affected by what happened

who_did_what_agent.name: Who did the action in a sentence

who_did_what_patient.name: Who or what the action was done to

state.name: What something is or is like ('the sky is blue')

state_closure.name: Keeping a fact true until something changes it

wic.name: Which meaning of a word is meant in this sentence

scws_graded_meaning.name: How a word's meaning shifts with its context (graded)

coarse_sense.name: Picking the right broad sense of an ambiguous word (older test set)

natural_logic_monotonicity.name: Drawing safe conclusions from 'is a kind of' facts

selective_reliability.patient_defer.name: Knowing when to hold back on 'who was acted on'

selective_reliability.obl_defer.name: Knowing when to hold back on a place or time attachment

causal_multihop.wiqa_multihop.name: Following a chain of causes across several steps

causal_multihop.tellmewhy_nonadjacent.name: Answering 'why' when the cause is sentences away

grounding_coverage_quality.name: Working out what a new word means from reading

causal_sign.name: Whether a cause makes an effect bigger or smaller

predictive_causal_necessity.name: Whether one event was needed for another to happen

affect_harm_help.name: Whether an action helped or harmed someone

occ_appraisal.name: How a character probably feels about an event

theory_of_mind.name: What a character believes, even when it is false

event_goal_congruence.name: Whether an event helps or blocks a character's goal

temporal_before_after.name: Which of two events came first

temporal_overlap.name: Whether two events happened at the same time

temporal_survival.name: Whether a state still holds at a later point

temporal_implicit_order.name: Event order when the text does not say it outright

spatial_relational.name: Where things are relative to each other

sem_segmentation.name: Noticing where one scene ends and another begins
